evaluation_value: current_score before the target player's move; raw_loss and disc_loss are not used
evaluation_cutoff: first qualifying target node inside the inclusive strict-ply range
time_search: earliest node satisfying the v1 time rule, strictly before the evaluation cutoff; search through the cap when no cutoff exists
time_comparison: current_thinking_time_ms > time_multiplier * median(all prior same-player non-pass thinking times)
anchor_selection: time anchor before cutoff when present; otherwise evaluation cutoff; otherwise no_anchor
recorded_time_policy: only player views explicitly listed by source games.csv recorded_sides are analyzed
